parameters.content:
## 🌐 Workflow 8 — CareerPulse: OAuth Job Hunter Web App, Split-Screen Studio & Career Academy

### 1. Public Career & Interview Academy (`GET /webhook/job-dashboard`)
- **Career & Analytics Blog**, **18+ Interview-Ready Q&A Vault**, **6-Pillar Interview Preparation Blueprint & Interactive Checklist**, and **30-60-90 Day Job Success Playbook**.

### 2. OAuth Protected Owner Command Center (`POST /webhook/job-dashboard-api`)
- **Desktop Split-Screen Studio**: Job Details, Control Buttons & Section Rewriter on the Left + Embedded Google Drive PDF & Live A4 Document Preview on the Right (`📄 Custom Resume` ↔ `✉️ Cover Letter` ↔ `🎓 Master Resume`).
- **Graphical Funnel & Analytics**, **Interactive Master Table**, **`Generate new jobs` (Non-Collision Batch 25)**, **LinkedIn Queue + `li_at` Cookie**, **Friends & HR Network**, and **Learned Rules & Portals Vault**.
